t: Here in Green Park you're looking at the Diana Fountain, also called Diana of the Treetops. It shows the mythological Diana with her traditional greyhound, standing on a circular platform held up by stylized tree branches. The sculptor was Estcourt J Clack, an English sculptor who lived from 1906 to 1973, and he made the piece. The park and statue sit in the City of Westminster, in central London. Notice how the branches seem to lift the goddess above the ground, which gives the fountain its distinctive look.
